=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- File: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh
  Line: ~88 (the `_embed_input_file` wc-size block after last-run edit)
  Problem: `_size=... || true`; then `if ! [[ "${_size}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then printf '(omitted ...)\n'; return 0; fi`.
  Why it fails at runtime: any wc failure, locale quirk, or pipe error that leaves non-numeric output is now treated as "omit silently" with no log entry or sentinel. The judge receives an incomplete prompt while the budget accounting believes every input was processed. The earlier editor pass intended to harden the path but replaced a detectable error with silent data loss. (Validated against the exact hunk in last_run_diff.patch and the pass-1 reviewer output that flagged the same site.)
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh
  Line: ~410-430 and trap line ~466 (RB_JUDGE_PR_DIFF_FILE / RB_JUDGE_PR_DIFF_TMP_FILE handling)
  Problem: PR diff is fetched to a runtime file, truncated in-place (or via head -c fallback), then `PR_DIFF="$(cat ...)"`; cleanup lives only in the EXIT trap.
  Why it fails at runtime: a SIGTERM, runner kill, or non-zero exit before the trap fires leaves the temp files in $RUNTIME_DIR. On repeated review-blocked runs this pollutes the workspace and violates the "cleanup even on partial failure" contract used elsewhere in the reviewer scripts. The last autofix improved truncation but did not add a pre-trap guard or explicit rm on every error path. (Backed by the exact change in last_run_diff.patch lines 378-436 and the trap edit.)
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- File: .github/workflows/ci.yml (and duplicate sites in mark-stable.yml:213, test-and-mark-stable.yml:3229)
  Line: the added `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/test_orchestrate_integration_ahead_by_gate.py` and `test_review_autofix_editor_noop_cascade_contract.py` entries
  Problem: The same two test files are now listed verbatim in three separate workflow allowlists.
  Why it fails at runtime: the tests continue to run, but any future addition or removal must be replicated in all three places, violating the "single source of truth" pattern established when the explicit direct-run allowlists were first extracted. The last autofix addressed the Copilot comments but introduced the duplication rather than factoring the list.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
